atomico._readme: Durable identity corrections consumed by build-company-base.py on every rebuild (COLLECTION.md §8): one company rendered under different names across Atomico's seven listing eras (2008 Flash, 2008-2010 PHP, 2011 fund pages, 2012-2017 /portfolio, 2018-2019 /partnerships, 2019-2021 /investments, 2021-2026 /partners CMS) and the Getro job board, plus renames. Canonical = the company's current brand as the firm or the company renders it.

merges.name: Ankar
merges.reason: the CMS renders 'Ankar' (atomico.com/partners/ankar), the job board 'Ankar AI' (ankar.ai); one company

merges.name: Jobandtalent
merges.reason: the 2021+ CMS renders 'Job&Talent', the older listings and the job board 'Jobandtalent' (jobandtalent.com); the company's own brand is Jobandtalent

merges.name: Pactum
merges.reason: CMS 'Pactum', job board and Form D 'Pactum AI' (pactum.com); one company

merges.name: Pelago
merges.reason: CMS 'Pelago', job board 'Pelago Health' (pelagohealth.com), and the 2021 page 'Quit Genius' (atomico.com/partners/quitgenius): Quit Genius renamed itself Pelago, and the firm's 2024 post says it co-led the Series B 'back in 2021' of the same company; one company; and the Form D issuer 'Digital Therapeutics, Inc.' (CIK 1805173), whose 2024 filing names the Quit Genius founders Sherwani, Siddiqui and Ahmed as executive officers and Ben Blume as director - Pelago's legal entity

merges.name: StarkWare
merges.reason: CMS 'StarkWare Industries' (the legal name), job board 'StarkWare' (starkware.co); published as the brand, matching Sequoia's row

merges.name: Fat Llama
merges.reason: the 2019-2020 pages spell 'Fat Lama', the 2021+ CMS 'Fat Llama' (fatllama.com); one company

merges.name: iBoxChain
merges.reason: iBoxPay (2012-2020 listings) is iBoxChain (2021+ CMS: 'iBoxChain ... mobile card reader and payments provider in China', founder Hansen Han); the company's current name

merges.name: Omio
merges.reason: GoEuro renamed Omio in 2019 (2016-2019 pages /portfolio/goeuro, /partnerships/goeuro; 2020+ Omio)

merges.name: Upside Foods
merges.reason: Memphis Meats renamed Upside Foods in 2021 (2017-2020 pages memphis-meats, 2021+ upside-foods)

merges.name: Gengo
merges.reason: myGengo (2011 fund II page) renamed Gengo (2012+ pages)

merges.name: TrialPay
merges.reason: the 2008 Flash-era file is named trialplay.xml; the 2008 listing renders 'TrialPay'

merges.name: Jawbone
merges.reason: Aliph (2010-2011 fund I pages) renamed Jawbone in 2011 (2008 and 2012+ listings: Jawbone)

merges.name: The Climate Corporation
merges.reason: WeatherBill (2008-2011 listings, fund I; Form D 'WeatherBill Inc') renamed The Climate Corporation in 2011 (Form D 'Climate Corp'); acquired by Monsanto 2013

merges.name: Wellhub
merges.reason: Gympass rebranded Wellhub in 2024 (the CMS page: 'Wellhub (formerly Gympass)'); one company

merges.name: Bird
merges.reason: MessageBird rebranded Bird in 2024 (CMS /partners/messagebird to 2024, /partners/bird after, same founder Robert Vis); published as Accel publishes it. NOT the scooter company Bird Rides (Sequoia's row): distinct

merges.name: IMA
merges.reason: Fashiolista (2011-2012 fund-II listings) renamed its company IMA in 2015 when the consumer platform closed; the firm's CMS page 'IMA' (atomico.com/partners/ima, invest year 2010) links fashiolista.com; one position

merges.name: Aplo
merges.reason: the CMS page 'SheeldMarket' (2022 capture, lead Siraj Khaliq) and the later page 'Aplo' (2025 capture) both link sheeldmarket.com: SheeldMarket renamed itself Aplo; one company

merges.name: Fab
merges.reason: Hem (the firm's 2015 listing) is Fab's 2014-2015 pivot, not a second position: Fab.com's own furniture line, run from Fab's Berlin business on Fab's money (TechCrunch 2015-12-30: the founders 'raised over $300 million ... from investors that included Andreessen Horowitz, Atomico'); Atomico's shares are the 2012 Series C it led. The Fab brand's US assets went to PCH in March 2015 and the Hem business was sold in February 2016; one company

merges.name: Vay
merges.reason: the 2019-2021 /investments/ listing 'Ree Technology' is Ree Technology GmbH, the Berlin teledriving company renamed Vay Technology GmbH on 2021-09-30 (the register at Amtsgericht Charlottenburg; deutsche-startups 2019-06-17: 'Atomico ... und Creandum investieren gemeinsam rund 10 Millionen Euro in das junge Berliner Startup Ree Technology'); the CMS page is 'Vay' (vay.io). Not REE Automotive. One company

never_merge.reason: Hailo (the 2011 investment) and Free Now (the mytaxi joint venture that acquired Hailo in 2016): the acquirer is a consideration row, never the same company
